## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

How do I pay for Indonesian company reports?
Search for a company, add reports to your cart, proceed to checkout, and pay securely by credit

Most reports are delivered within one business day. The expected delivery time is displayed at
checkout.

AHU/OSS.
Why haven't I received the report I ordered?
It could be due to:

2. **Spam folder** – Check your spam/junk mail.

What if I ordered the same report twice?
If a duplicate order occurs, we’ll refund the extra payment or provide a replacement report.
Are your reports valid for international due diligence?
Yes, our reports are sourced from official Indonesian registries and are widely accepted for KYC,
AML, and cross-border compliance checks.
How do I remove my company from Companies House Indonesia?
We don’t manually add or remove records. Data is synced with official registries.

# HAMMERSMITH TATTOO LONDON

## Professional Tattooing Since 2007

[BOOK AN APPOINTMENT ][15]

## About Studio

Founded in 2007, Hammersmith Tattoo London has earned its place as  a leading studio on West
London's North End Road, blending award wining craftsmanship with a reputation for quality,
creativity and care.


With over decade of industry experience, we've been recognised at both UK and international tattoo
conventions, reflecting the skill and passion of our dedicated [artists][16].

Our diverse team specialises in a broad spectrum of styles from[ fine-line][17] and realism to
illustrative and custom designes ensuring every client receives work tailored to their vision.

At Hammersmith Tattoo, we believe in honest guidance, creative collaboration, and delivering tattoos
you'll be proud of for life.

## Opening Hours

Mon 11am - 7pm

Tue - Sat 11am - 8pm

Sun 12pm - 6pm

For the most up-to-date information on our opening hours, including holidays, special events, and
bank holidays place check our [Google Business Page][18].

We regularly update it to reflect any changes to our schedule.

For detailed news and announcements about our hours, visit the [Blog][19] section on our website, we
keep it current so you'll always know when we're open.

Stay connected for the latest updates, and we look forward to welcoming you at Hammersmith Tattoo
London!

## Walk-in Tattoos

No Appointment? No Problem.


Looking for a spontaneous tattoo? Whether it's a flash design or a quick custom piece, our artists
at Hammersmith Tattoo London are ready to welcome walk-ins every day.

For the best possible experience, we recommend calling us at [020 7602 1086][20] before you visit.
This allows us to check [artist][21] availability and make sure we can give you tattoo the time and
attention it deserves.

Prefer to drop by? You're always welcome. Out team will do their best to accommodate you on the
spot.

Because great tattoos shouldn't have to wait.

## Reviews

Discover why we're a top choice for tattoos at Hammersmith Tattoo London! Check out our Google page
where more than 700 reviews have given us a 5-star rating. These testimonials reflect the high
quality and exceptional craftsmanship of our work. Visit now to see why our clients consistently
rate us so highly!

[GOOGLE REVIEWS ][22]

## Best Tattoo Shops in London 2025

Hammersmith Tattoo is widely acclaimed and proudly featured on the Best Tattoo Shops in London list.

[LIST][23]

## Tattoo Styles
## Your Vision, Our Craft

At Hammersmith Tattoo London, we believe every tattoo is a personal story waiting to be told. That's
why our studio brings together a team experienced [artists][24], each specialising in distinct
styles from [fine-line][25], realism, and [blackwork][26] to [traditional][27],[
neo-traditional][28], [Japanese][29], geometric, and illustrative [designs][30].

Whether you have a clear vision or seek creative guidance, our [artists][31] work with you to craft
a design that reflects your individuality. We combine artistic excellence with precise technique to
ensure every piece is unique, high quality, and made to last.

With a strong commitment to professionalism, hygiene, and a welcoming atmosphere, we provide a safe
environment where creativity thrives.

Step into Hammersmith Tattoo London where ideas become art, and [styles][32] meet craftmanship.

market is dominated by two major thread types: PDO and PCL. The two offer aesthetic benefits by
using minimal procedures to rejuvenate the face. Nonetheless, they differ significantly in
composition, duration, and lifting capacity. When practitioners and patients understand these
differences, critical treatment decisions can be reached. Learning about Thread Lift Foundations  
What Thread Lifts Do Thread lifts involve the placement of medical-grade threads beneath the skin to
lift sagging tissue. The threads provide instant mechanical raising and also activate collagen
regeneration. The combination of the two produces both immediate and gradual outcomes. How They Work
Practitioners insert needles through punctures to place threads. The fibers fasten to tissue, which
produces tension upwards. New collagen is then formed around the threads as the body reacts to them.

market is dominated by two major thread types: PDO and PCL. The two offer aesthetic benefits by
using minimal procedures to rejuvenate the face. Nonetheless, they differ significantly in
composition, duration, and lifting capacity. When practitioners and patients understand these
differences, critical treatment decisions can be reached. Learning about Thread Lift Foundations

lift sagging tissue. The threads provide instant mechanical raising and also activate collagen
regeneration. The combination of the two produces both immediate and gradual outcomes. How They Work
Practitioners insert needles through punctures to place threads. The fibers fasten to tissue, which
produces tension upwards. New collagen is then formed around the threads as the body reacts to them.

What is nature worth? It's both priceless and worth many trillions. Here's how it props up our lives
and economies, and what we can do to help it.

## Stepping Up Progress in this Defining Decade

Alongside communities, we’re urgently clearing obstacles and finding solutions to the climate and
biodiversity crises.

[Who We Are][60]

We are dedicated staff, scientists and members advancing effective, lasting conservation in more
than 80 countries and territories.

[What We Do][61]

To make the highest possible impact on the climate and biodiversity crises between now and 2030,
we’re developing breakthrough ideas, amplifying local leaders and influencing policy.

[How To Help][62]

There are so many ways to make positive change for our planet. Volunteer with us. Learn how to
reduce your carbon footprint. Donate to conservation work.

[Where We Work][63]

Dense rainforests, remote coral reefs and the hearts of major cities. Our strategies are as diverse
as the habitats and geographies in which we work.

the dual threats of climate change and biodiversity loss across 80+ countries and territories.

# Tattoo And Cosmetic Care.**

### **Australia's leading numbing and aftercare solution for cosmetic procedures and tattoos.**

Numbd offers the best in tattoo care with pharmaceutically formulated, cruelty-free products,
proudly Australian made and owned. We’re dedicated to changing the tattoo experience with our
high-quality numbing and aftercare products. Based in South Australia, our products are designed to

### **Now Offering Afterpay!**

At Numbd, we know quality matters, and paying for it should be easy. With Afterpay, you can grab
what you need now and pay it off with interest-free installments. It’s a simple, stress-free way to
get the best for your skin while staying on budget.

### **Got Questions? We’ve got answers.**
* How long does the numbing cream last?
  
  Numbd 10% numbing cream typically provides effective numbing for 6 to 8 hours. The duration can
  vary based on your skin type and proper application. Generally, you can expect 2 to 6 hours of
  pain relief.
* How long before my tattoo or cosmetic procedure should I apply the numbing cream?
  
  For optimal results, apply Numbd 10% cream for at least 60 minutes and up to 90 minutes before
  your procedure or tattoo.
  
  **Important Information:**
  * Ensure the cream is 100% removed before starting the procedure or tattoo.
  * This product is only to be used on unbroken skin.
  * Ensure that the cream is applied evenly and covers the entire area to be treated for the full
    effect.
* How often do I need to apply the after-care glide stick?
  
  Apply the Aftercare Glide Stick 2-3 times a day to maintain moisture and promote healing for your
  tattoo and skin.
* How many after-care glide sticks will I need for my tattoo?
  
  For larger tattoos and extensive coverage areas, we recommend having multiple glide sticks on
  hand. This ensures that your tattoo heals evenly and reduces the risk of dryness or irritation.

1. Wash and dry the area thoroughly (shave if needed).

How much cream do I need for a tattoo?

When should I apply the cream before my appointment?

Yes, but patch test on a small spot first, and consult with your artist.

# Services
* Tattoos - Starting at $100
  
  Tattoos are the backbone of Storyline. While we seek to meet all of our client’s needs and styles,
  we specialize in the following tattoo styles: Fine Line, Realism, Woodcut, Blackwork, Script, Tiny
  Tattoos and Floral. Unsure if we would be a good fit for you? Please feel free to submit a tattoo
  request with us and we will either provide you with a free quote or recommend a tattoo artist to
  you that would be a good fit for what you are wanting. We also encourage all of our potential
  clients to visit our social media pages to see our work!
* Piercings - Starting at $40
  
  We offer piercing services for Ears, Nose, and Navel. We utilize high quality implant grade
  titanium earring in gold and silver. Additionally, other than hoops, our earrings are state of the
  art “flat back” design make for comfort and easy healing. Our full list of services can be found
  by clicking the button below.
* Permanent Jewelry - Starting at $30
  
  Permanent Jewelry are clasp-less bracelets, anklets, and necklaces that are quickly and safely
  welded in place for a comfortable, “set it and forget it” timeless everyday look.
  
  We also offer the addition of claspes, charms, connectors and more. With or lifetime guarantee
  that comes with free resizes and repairs for life, you can purchase your jewelry with peace of
  mind!

**Bridging the gap between the tattoo industry and advanced dermatology care.**

#### Neutralize the Pain

**Appreciate the Art.**

We maintain a fiercely independent approach to product research and development. Our team of skilled
chemical scientists conceptualizes product ideas, researching blends, and creating prototypes. We
source ingredients from the most reputable suppliers across the globe, then marry contemporary
technology with long-established scientific practices.

[Tac Sciences Tattoo Anesthetic Cream Jar]

**+ Dermatologist Formulated**

Developed in collaboration with board-certified dermatologists and industry-leading tattoo artists
to ensure fast and effective pain relief.


**+ Artist Tested & Approved**

One of the main reasons people do not get tattoos is because of the pain associated with the
application. However, with this professional tattoo numbing solution by TAC, you can give your
customers the beautiful tattoo they’ve always wanted without the pain that they fear.

The only tattoo anesthetic cream suitable for use during the shading session.

Clinical strength topical anesthetic cream that targets and neutralizes tattoo pain at the source.
TAC Sciences Tattoo Anesthetic Cream is available in individually packaged 1-ounce jars and 0.25
single use packets to professionally licensed tattoo artists and tattoo shops.

## TattooNumbx

Our Tattoo Numbing Cream has been designed by tattoo artists in the US and is used to make
tattooing/procedures comfortable. Our numbing cream is used to help you sit longer through a tattoo
session, so you can get more done. The cream has a lightweight, non-greasy formula that doesn’t
leave the skin oily and does not affect the artist, ink, or the healing of the tattoo. It can be
applied to any area for temporary relief. 

TattooNumbx [Tattoo Numbing Cream][26] can be used for tattoos, laser tattoo removal, cosmetic
tattooing, microneedling, waxing, and a wide range of cosmetic procedures. Once applied, the numbing
cream starts working in as little as 30 minutes and lasts anywhere between 3 and 5 hours (some
people have said it lasts longer). The cream can be reapplied for longer sessions. 

All our numbing cream products have genuine holographic, anti-counterfeit labels that can be
verified. TattooNumbx also offers a wide range of products for tattoos/treatments
including [Aftercare Gel][27], [Aftercare Balm][28], Numbing Spray & tattooist
wholesale [Multipacks][29].

Frequently Asked Questions

What is tattoo numbing cream used for?

Tattoo numbing cream is most commonly used before tattoo sessions, but it has a wide range of other
uses too. Suitable for use anywhere on the body when used as directed, it is commonly applied before
laser tattoo removal, laser hair removal, waxing, injections, blood tests, vaccinations, lip
fillers, permanent makeup, piercings, and other cosmetic skin treatments.

How long should I leave tattoo numbing cream on for?

TattooNumbx should be applied at least 60 minutes before your tattoo session. For best results, we
recommend applying it 90 minutes before your appointment. For procedures longer than 3 hours, the
cream should be reapplied as directed to the area.

Will the tattoo numbing cream effect my ink?

No. Our tattoo numbing cream works alongside the tattooing process without affecting your ink,
tattoo results, or the skin’s natural healing process.

How long does tattoo numbing cream last for?

Our tattoo numbing cream lasts for up to 3–5 hours if applied as directed. Over time, the effects
will gradually wear off and sensitivity will start to return to the application area.

How much will one tube of tattoo numbing cream cover?

TattooNumbx - 10g tube, is enough to cover the area of the forearm if applied with a thick layer as
directed.

TattooNumbx should be applied at least 60 minutes before your tattoo session. For best results, we
recommend applying it 90 minutes before your appointment. For procedures longer than 3 hours, the
cream should be reapplied as directed to the area.

tattoo results, or the skin’s natural healing process.

will gradually wear off and sensitivity will start to return to the application area.

How much will one tube of tattoo numbing cream cover?

TattooNumbx - 10g tube, is enough to cover the area of the forearm if applied with a thick layer as

session, so you can get more done. The cream has a lightweight, non-greasy formula that doesn’t
leave the skin oily and does not affect the artist, ink, or the healing of the tattoo. It can be
applied to any area for temporary relief.

tattooing, microneedling, waxing, and a wide range of cosmetic procedures. Once applied, the numbing

verified. TattooNumbx also offers a wide range of products for tattoos/treatments

A tattoo is considered a fashion statement and people of all ages from teen to old age more often
take a tattoo. Most people know that putting a tattoo can be a painful procedure and that’s why
numbing creams like TKTX have been invented. The needles of the tattoo artist press into your skin
and a work of art is created for life. Even though the tattoo artists believe that pain is a part of
tattooing, they are open to TKTX numbing creams.

TKTX is an anesthetic ointment that can be applied to the skin to suppress the pain of tattooing.
TKTX is an numbing cream that is used all over the world and that works effectively against pain.
People who have a low pain threshold are in this way are sooner persuaded to have a tattoo.

## Genuine TKTX Numbing Cream

When it comes to tattoo numbing cream, cheapest doesn’t always mean best! Although you might find
some alleged TKTX creams on websites such as Wish, Etsy, Amazon and eBay that sell them for half the
price of TKTX Official, you can’t trust them. Fake sites often take your money and don’t ship
anything – anything they do ship can cause serious harm, affect the ink and your skin and quite
often don’t work at all. Here at TKTX Official we are proud to be the only certified distributor of
TKTX numbing cream.

Some of the advertised fake creams are even called ‘TKTX’ – they may even look similar to our site.
When looking to buy a numbing cream you need to make sure you are thoroughly checking every aspect
of the cream and website. With similar packaging and fake certificates and holograms, the TKTK cream
could easily be mistaken for TKTX if full attention is not given. See our FAQ’s for more info!

When it comes to tattoo numbing cream, cheapest doesn’t always mean best! Although you might find
some alleged TKTX creams on websites such as Wish, Etsy, Amazon and eBay that sell them for half the
